law: Use this API if your app uses API and provides alternative payment options for digital goods and services, using any of the following: Payment Service Providers (PSP) : An alternative payment processor that lets customers complete transactions within your app.
Calls to the API require JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authorization.
To report an unrecognized token, when you receive an App Store Server Notification about a token that you don’t have recorded in your system.
